messages:
From: Emma Stone <emma.stone@midwest-retail.com>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 16 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New supplier — invoice delivery preference?

Hi Sergio,

We're setting up Redwood as a new vendor in our AP system (company: Midwest Retail Co.). Quick question while we finish the onboarding form: who will be listed as the invoice sender?

Options from our side are:
- Portal push (we can ingest invoices via your portal webhook)
- PDF to ap-team@midwest-retail.com with a standard subject line

A couple constraints: we require a PO number on the invoice and an XML or PDF sample so our ingestion team can map fields. If you're able to push via portal, we also need a contact for portal onboarding and an expected first-file date.

Can you confirm how Redwood prefers to send invoices and share a sample? I can loop in our integration team if needed.

Thanks,
Emma Stone\AP Manager — Midwest Retail Co.
Attachments: midwest_ap_requirements.pdf (PDF, 230KB)
From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: Emma Stone <emma.stone@midwest-retail.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 16 May 2027 09:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New supplier — invoice delivery preference?

Emma — thanks for the note and the requirements doc. Looping in Ben (billing ops) and Kimberly (platform) to confirm the best path.

Short answer: we can support both delivery modes, but we prefer customers opt into our portal webhook for guaranteed parsing and automated PO reconciliation. Benefits: deterministic subject/metadata, signed delivery, and we can confirm receipt programmatically.

If Midwest needs a temporary email-only flow (PDF to ap-team@midwest-retail.com) while portal is being stood up, we can do that too — Redwood will send a matching machine-readable XML attachment so you can map fields. We typically include:
- line-item SKU mapping
- unit price and tax/VAT breakdowns
- PO reference in the invoice header

Request from our side: can you confirm whether Midwest requires VAT breakdown on each line vs a total VAT line? Also, can you provide the first PO sample number to include on the sample invoice?

Proposed next steps:
1) If portal: Kimberly will share the webhook spec and a short onboarding checklist; expected time: 5 business days from kickoff.
2) If email: Ben will send a sample PDF+XML invoice and a naming convention to use for the subject line.

Happy to run a short call with your integration lead — available this week.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182
From: Emma Stone <emma.stone@midwest-retail.com>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: AP Team <ap-team@midwest-retail.com>
Date: Mon, 16 May 2027 10:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New supplier — invoice delivery preference?

Thanks Sergio — appreciate the flexibility. For now Midwest will opt for the email push to ap-team@midwest-retail.com and we'll plan to move to portal ingestion in Q3.

Answers:
- VAT: we need VAT broken out per line item for EU-origin goods; a total VAT line is acceptable for other cases. Please include both fields in your sample.
- First PO sample: PO-94571 (this will help our mapping team)

Can you send the sample XML and a PDF copy using our subject format: "INV|Midwest|PO-94571|YYYYMMDD"? Once I see the sample I'll route to integration and confirm a staging date.

Emma
